description.en: Ignites the bomb on contact and explodes, dealing deadly damage to all plants in an area.
description.zh: 碰到植物后，能引爆手里的炸弹，对大范围植物造成致命伤害。

chat.en: Bomb Zombie has little facilities in kongfu, making him embarrassed staying with other kongfu learners. He's humble until he found his talent in pyrotechnic.
chat.zh: 自爆僵尸没有武功天分, 所以他一直很自卑地待在少林寺, 直到他发现了自己的火药天分后, 地位骤升。

text.en: explodes and damages heavily to nearby plants on contact
text.zh: 碰到植物自爆并对范围内植物造成巨量伤害

text.en: loses his bomb when his arm is broken
